brief:
全球科技股因 AI 交易情绪紧绷而下跌，美元走弱，投资者等待本周关键芯片财报以检验涨势的成色；油价则在中东紧张局势下走高。中国贷款市场报价利率（LPR）连续第 17 个月保持不变，显示货币政策保持定力，同时三季度经济在强劲出口带动下加速。中东地缘风险波及资本市场，沙特因胡塞武装袭击推迟"沙漠达沃斯"FII 峰会。产业层面，英伟达拿下快速成长的 AI 初创公司 Modal 以强化中央处理器布局，Waymo 计划将无人驾驶车队扩至 2 万辆；大众押注小鹏以拯救中国业务却未达预期。

1. [科技股因 AI 担忧下跌、美元走弱](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-19/stock-market-today-dow-s-p-live-updates) —— AI 交易情绪紧绷，本周财报将检验芯片股涨势。
2. [中国 LPR 连续 17 个月保持不变](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQdVB0amh2R1lRc3VyUHZUMS1fcHZQeklxdjVOekRHRy0tUTBEa1U2aFlWRXdiNk0xamxUc1hrU0hmbEZBRVptMEIxRS11N1lvZk05Nkh1MDF1bUtONzlIZkFRSlpWcTNaRGxPcVZka2FrbXBSVEU0VUs5eC1qSVp4TnRianA1QWNwbWFzck1aWGFZeW5kcElaWElFTl94X2gwUV80bmpzSkI2UQ?oc=5) —— 货币政策维持定力，连续第 17 个月按兵不动。
3. [中国三季度经济在出口带动下加速](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE0ybUNYYmVXU0VLLUUyQXM2UEFiLXhzWFF2YmZYZ3QwUWdiSkdBdHJIOXhTVGVEemNnYWNaWFU2TEJKcnpqOTY5WS1WekJBXzU5ek1zQVg0Uy0yQ0ktV1ZfSmMybVB6VFY3ZVNCeDhjcllNUG9BZUFRTWFuaHM0dw?oc=5) —— 强劲出口拉动三季度增长。
4. [英伟达收购快速成长的 AI 初创 Modal](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNUklvMHh4T2thUkdNSndrQ3BVOTZjalQwRnJ2ZFdhb3Q4aC1NT2k2LTBLX1AxZmlHdTdheHp1ZDF1ZGVSd2JLc3VFUU1ycWRndnRmS2ZyYVpGeU52OU9IQU5qVHdJb1BXNjJ1MlN4MF9aajQ5QXhmQnhYTXowWEFUa29BQkYySzBxeG1CU0Z0MHB6U3psLU1EcTB4Z3N2dkVYSFM3cEgtNlQ4Uk5VTlE?oc=5) —— 强化中央处理器（CPU）布局。
5. [大众押注小鹏拯救中国业务未达预期](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPVF81Q3ZqWE82a1RYZEpkbWFXNWVpMkZ2Z01MRFBUSGpCLUNncGh0S3JnRHJmZ0hYbHJFUTZkSE53Uks3Vm5USC1KcTNTYTdfY19BSHdFdElhUG8zNG5rWHRoNzNzaWVhQkhzRVZfcE1hanNubFRzalNlUHdqc1dHSXZpTXc5SW1zUndSZ1dZdUx5WDlQMGhEM2ZHNWlMdmJqbDM0TGFEbDVCSFE2UmpXYW5oUG5YazBMTFlYS2wyNHJkbFF0dkI0QQ?oc=5) —— 深度报道揭示合作进展不顺。

items.title: Tech Stocks Decline on AI Jitters, Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Technology shares came under renewed pressure as sentiment toward the artificial intelligence trade remained jittery ahead of key earnings reports this week that will test the strength of gains in chip stocks. The dollar weakened.

items.title: GCash Parent Mynt Open to Acquisitions After IPO
items.summary: Mynt President and CEO Martha Sazon says the company will use proceeds from its listing to expand GCash, focusing on lending, financial services, and international markets. She also says Mynt is open to acquisitions and partnerships. She appeared on Bloomberg's Insight with Haslinda Amin. (Source: B...

items.title: FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Set to Fall as European Weakness Extends
Indonesia Stocks Rebound as Questions Persist Over Market Fix
items.summary: Indonesian stocks rebounded after authorities moved to stave off a potential two-step downgrade by MSCI Inc., though questions remain over whether the measures go far enough to address the index provider’s concerns.

items.title: Saudi Arabia Postpones FII Summit After Houthi Attacks
items.summary: Saudi Arabia has postponed its flagship conference, the Future Investment Initiative (FII), to 2027. The decision follows multiple attacks on the kingdom in recent days. Bloomberg's Onur Ant reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: GCash Owner Gains in Debut After Record Philippines IPO
items.summary: Mynt Inc., the operator of the mobile-payments app GCash, gained in its debut Tuesday after the biggest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines that the company said it sees as setting it up for potential acquisitions and to expand lending as well as its financial services offerings.

items.title: Japanese Investors Buy Most Domestic Government Bonds Since 2009
items.summary: Japanese investors’ purchases of domestic government bonds climbed to the highest in 17 years in the fiscal first half, a move that some analysts said reflected an attempt by pension funds to rebalance their portfolios.

items.title: Turkey Removes Market Regulator Chief During Fund Crisis
items.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan removed the country’s market regulator chief Mahmut Sutcu following his resignation bid amid a fallout of a fund crisis that’s upended the country’s markets.

items.title: Shaker: Demand in Mecca Driven by Faith not Cycles

items.summary: Australia’s market watchdog is gathering information about Firmus Grid Ltd.’s failed initial public offering, though it hasn’t yet opened an official probe.

items.summary: The monthslong debate on the oil-rich province’s future exposed deep divisions that might not be easily mended.

items.summary: The president said he would be willing to discuss denuclearization with the leaders of Russia and China.

items.summary: Mining companies have invested billions of dollars in new gold mines to cash in on near-record-high prices for the metal.

items.title: Young Protesters Are Putting India’s Modi on the Defensive
items.summary: Narendra Modi’s government has a reputation for being heavy-handed toward dissent, but its tactics in recent days have been met with a mix of wit and defiance by young protesters.

items.summary: A judge ruled that Abdulrahman Alfozan should be held without bail after a Saudi consulate had offered to pay for his release.

items.title: Oil Futures Pull Back as U.S. Waives Some Russia Sanctions
items.summary: Oil futures fell, pulling back from Friday’s gains after President Trump waived newly imposed sanctions on Russia, while persistent Middle East supply risks kept prices afloat.

items.summary: Opinion polls suggest the election is deadlocked, except for about a million Arab voters whose backing comes with drawbacks in a polarized society.

items.title: 中期选举前景打压美国军工股
items.summary: 随着投资者押注民主党将在中期选举中拿下国会两院控制权，进而阻挠特朗普增加5000亿美元军费支出的计划，美国军工股走势低迷。

items.title: 叫板星链：欧洲电信运营商探索卫星移动服务
items.summary: 德国电信、Orange、西班牙电信和沃达丰将探讨联合竞标无线电频谱资源的可能性，从而使他们能够在欧洲提供“终端直连”卫星移动服务。

items.title: 极右翼崛起危及德国吸引外资努力
items.summary: 欧洲商界领袖警告，德国选择党近期在州选举中胜出，令人担忧德国政治稳定，包括担心本届德国政府还能不能兑现改革承诺。

items.title: 卢拉试图借助自拍视频扭转选情
items.summary: 曾坦承自己没有手机的巴西左翼总统，为了赢得总统大选第二轮投票而推出一系列自拍视频，包括他在健身房跑步机上对着镜头讲话的视频。
